task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_MIDDLE from the box stack to INSPECTION_TABLE. Since only the top box can be picked (stack rule), first remove BOX_TOP and temporarily place it on TEMP_TABLE, then pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack minus the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is on top of the stack (BOX_BOTTOM → BOX_MIDDLE → BOX_TOP), so it must be removed first before BOX_MIDDLE can be accessed
TEMP_TABLE is available as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP
After BOX_TOP is removed, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the top of the stack and can be picked
Placing BOX_TOP onto BOX_BOTTOM will result in a stack of BOX_BOTTOM → BOX_TOP, correctly removing only the middle layer
Navigating to object coordinates with tolerance 1.0 brings the robot within its interaction_distance of 2.0
